title: Deleting files crashes editor when there is no trash folder
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in v4.5.stable.arch_linux and v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 17 Oct 2025 13:29:06 +0000 on Tty - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Graphics (radeonsi, renoir, ACO, DRM 3.64, 6.17.3-arch2-1) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 14.95 GiB memory

### Issue description

When setting up a project on a disk that does not have a trash folder, deleting any file or folder from the editor crashes the godot editor.

The error message is:
```gio: file:///data/projects/godot/erreproduce/delete_file_crash/new%20folder: Unable to find or create trash directory /data/.Trash-1000 to trash /data/projects/godot/erreproduce/delete_file_crash/new folder
kf.kio.workers.file: Could not rename file "/data/projects/godot/erreproduce/delete_file_crash/new folder" to "/home/troido/.local/share/Trash/files/new folder"
kioclient5: Could not rename file /data/projects/godot/erreproduce/delete_file_crash/new folder.
ERROR: Could not create child process: gvfs-trash
   at: execute (drivers/unix/os_unix.cpp:749)
amdgpu: The CS has been rejected, see dmesg for more information (-22).
```

The problem is the same as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/111477 but I do not agree with the author that godot should not have to handle this.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a new project on any drive that does not have a trash folder
  - In my case it is an ext4 filesystem. The root folder/mount point is owned by the root user, but the subdirectory in which the project is placed is owned by the current user
- Create a new file or directory
- Remove that file or directory

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Any new project will do
